title: 粉尘、烟尘与纳米材料
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/151_粉尘、烟尘与纳米材料.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/151_粉尘、烟尘与纳米材料/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着防尘口罩，身边飘着细小尘粒
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears a white particulate respirator mask, tiny dust specks floating around it, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第13章第五课：粉尘、烟尘与纳米材料。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着阳光里飞舞的尘粒
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at dust specks dancing in a beam of sunlight from a window.
shots.narration: 看不见的细尘，最容易吸进肺里。

shots.scene: 阿杰在敞开的台面上称取一大瓶细粉，粉尘飘起
shots.prompt_en: In a university laboratory, the young male student scoops fine white powder on an open bench and a small dust cloud rises.
shots.narration: 阿杰在台面上称细粉，粉尘直飘。

shots.scene: 撒落的粉末被阿杰用刷子一扫，又扬起一片
shots.prompt_en: He brushes spilled powder off the bench with a dry brush, and more dust rises into the air.
shots.narration: 撒了点粉，他拿刷子一扫了之。

shots.scene: 阿杰咳嗽、揉眼睛
shots.prompt_en: The young male student coughs and rubs his eyes, a small cough icon near his face.
shots.narration: 没一会儿，他就咳嗽起来。

shots.scene: 小研拦住他，指向称量罩和湿抹布
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and points at a ventilated powder weighing enclosure and a damp cloth.
shots.narration: 小研：细粉进罩做，撒了湿擦。

shots.scene: 粉尘颗粒和更细的烟尘颗粒对比
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: coarse dust particles on the left and much finer fume particles on the right, floating in air. No text.
shots.narration: 粉尘是固体颗粒，飘在空气里。

shots.scene: 坩埚加热、燃烧冒出细烟
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a crucible heated in a furnace and a burning sample releasing a thin plume of fine smoke particles. No text.
shots.narration: 烟尘是加热、燃烧冒出的更细颗粒。

shots.scene: 颗粒越细进入呼吸道越深
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a human airway from nose to lungs, large particles stopped in the nose, tiny particles reaching deep air sacs. No text.
shots.narration: 颗粒越细，吸得越深。

shots.scene: 肺部出现纤维化斑点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pair of lungs with gray scarred spots spreading slowly, a long calendar beside. No text.
shots.narration: 长期吸入，可能引起尘肺病。

shots.scene: 眼鼻刺激、皮肤发红、哮喘图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, irritated red eyes, a sneezing nose and an asthma inhaler. No text.
shots.narration: 还会刺激眼鼻，引起过敏哮喘。

shots.scene: 法律书与粉尘图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a closed law book with a dust cloud icon and a warning sign. No text.
shots.narration: 粉尘是法定的职业病危害因素。

shots.scene: 标准书与空气采样器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a closed standard book next to a small personal air sampling pump clipped at a collar. No text.
shots.narration: 国家标准规定了接触限值。

shots.scene: 激光切割和电焊冒烟两个小图
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two small panels, a laser cutter releasing smoke and a welding torch releasing fume. No text.
shots.narration: 激光、焊接烟尘，另有专课。

shots.scene: 一排粉末瓶：硅藻土、石英砂、催化剂、颜料
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a row of jars holding fine powders, white filter aid, quartz sand, black catalyst powder and colored pigment. No text.
shots.narration: 实验室常用细粉，要防扬尘。

shots.scene: 干粉换成颗粒、溶液或膏状
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an arrow from a dusty dry powder jar to pellets, a solution bottle and a paste tube. No text.
shots.narration: 能用颗粒、溶液的，少用干粉。

shots.scene: 【实拍】在粉末称量罩内，用药匙称取无害细粉（手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: gloved hands weigh fine white powder on a balance inside a ventilated powder weighing enclosure.
shots.narration: 称取细粉，在通风柜或称量罩里。

shots.scene: 药匙贴近瓶口，轻轻转移
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a spatula held close to the mouth of a weighing boat, powder transferred gently with no dust. No text.
shots.narration: 勺子贴近容器口，轻拿轻放。

shots.scene: 从高处倒粉、使劲抖袋子，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: powder poured from high above a beaker and a bag shaken hard, a dust cloud, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 别从高处倒，也别使劲抖。

shots.scene: 用完立刻拧紧瓶盖
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand tightening the lid of a powder jar right after use. No text.
shots.narration: 用完马上盖紧瓶盖。

shots.scene: 穿实验服、戴手套护目镜，必要时戴防尘口罩
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a lab coat, nitrile gloves and safety goggles, with a particulate respirator mask ready on the bench.
shots.narration: 戴手套护目镜，必要时戴防尘口罩。

shots.scene: 研磨机、筛子加罩并接局部排风
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a grinding mill and a sieve shaker covered by a hood connected to a local exhaust duct with airflow arrows. No text.
shots.narration: 研磨过筛，加罩并开局部排风。

shots.scene: 纳米颗粒与细胞、头发的大小对比
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: tiny dots of nanoparticles beside a much larger cell and a giant hair strand for scale. No text.
shots.narration: 纳米材料，颗粒小到看不见。

shots.scene: 肺和皮肤旁边一个大问号
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: lungs and a patch of skin with a large question mark between them. No text.
shots.narration: 不少纳米材料的毒性，还没研究清。

shots.scene: 盾牌加高危害标记
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a shield icon raised in front of a nanoparticle cloud with a caution triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 不清楚，就按高危害从严防护。

shots.scene: 干粉换成液体分散液
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dry nanopowder jar with an arrow to a sealed bottle of liquid dispersion, the liquid marked with a check. No text.
shots.narration: 尽量用分散液，少碰干粉。

shots.scene: 干粉在手套箱或通风柜里操作
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: nanopowder handled inside a glove box and inside a fume hood with inward airflow arrows. No text.
shots.narration: 干粉放在手套箱或通风柜里操作。

shots.scene: 容器密封，贴标签
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sealed container with a blank label and a small nano dots icon on it. No text.
shots.narration: 容器密封，标签写明纳米材料。

shots.scene: 戴两层手套，穿实验服和护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on a second pair of gloves over the first, wearing a lab coat and safety goggles.
shots.narration: 戴两层手套，穿好实验服。

shots.scene: 沾染的纸巾手套装进密封袋
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: used wipes and gloves sealed in a zip bag, then placed into a hazardous waste container. No text.
shots.narration: 沾染物装密封袋，按危废处置。

shots.scene: 王老师和小研看风险评估表
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the female graduate student review a blank risk assessment form at a desk.
shots.narration: 新纳米材料，先做风险评估。

shots.scene: 玻璃棉、陶瓷纤维保温材料，细纤维放大
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a roll of glass wool insulation with a magnified view of sharp fine fibers. No text.
shots.narration: 玻璃棉等纤维，会扎手痒皮肤。

shots.scene: 戴手套护目镜取一小块玻璃棉
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in gloves and safety goggles picks up a small piece of glass wool with tweezers.
shots.narration: 取用时戴手套和护目镜。

shots.scene: 使劲抖动撕扯玻璃棉，纤维飞散，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: hands shaking and tearing glass wool hard, fibers flying in the air, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 别抖动、别撕扯，免得纤维飞扬。

shots.scene: 碎屑装袋封口丢弃
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: glass wool scraps placed in a bag, the bag sealed and put in a waste bin. No text.
shots.narration: 碎屑装袋封好，按规定丢弃。

shots.scene: 摘手套后洗手，不揉眼睛
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: hands washed at a sink after removing gloves, and a hand rubbing an eye crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 用完洗手，别用手揉眼睛。

shots.scene: 扫帚干扫、气枪吹粉，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dry broom sweeping powder and a compressed air gun blowing dust, both raising clouds, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 撒了粉，别干扫，也别用气吹。

shots.scene: 【实拍】用湿布由外向内擦拭台面撒落的无害粉末（手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: gloved hands wipe spilled white powder on a bench with a damp cloth, moving from the outside toward the center.
shots.narration: 用湿布，由外向里轻轻擦。

shots.scene: 带高效过滤器的吸尘器吸地面粉尘
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a vacuum cleaner with a high efficiency particulate filter collecting dust from a floor. No text.
shots.narration: 量大用带高效过滤的吸尘器。

shots.scene: 倒沙、刷炉渣扬尘，戴口罩
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person in a particulate respirator pours sand slowly and brushes ash from a furnace tray, dust kept low. No text.
shots.narration: 倒沙、刷炉灰，也会扬尘。

shots.scene: 废渣分类装袋
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: powder waste and residue sorted into labeled bags and placed in separate waste bins. No text.
shots.narration: 废渣分类装好，按学校规定处置。

shots.scene: 台面地面定期湿擦，不留积尘
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clean bench and floor being wet mopped, no dust layer on shelves. No text.
shots.narration: 台面地面定期湿擦，不留积尘。

shots.scene: 架顶积了厚厚一层可燃粉尘，警示
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thick layer of dust on top of a cabinet with a warning triangle and a small spark icon. No text.
shots.narration: 可燃粉尘积多了，还可能爆燃。

shots.scene: 防颗粒物口罩和普通口罩对比
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a particulate respirator mask with a check mark next to a cotton cloth mask with a cross. No text.
shots.narration: 防尘，要戴防颗粒物口罩。

shots.scene: 棉布口罩边缘透过细尘
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: fine dust passing through a cotton cloth mask and leaking around its edges. No text.
shots.narration: 棉布口罩，挡不住细粉尘。

shots.scene: 两本标准书和口罩
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two closed standard books beside a particulate respirator and a half mask with filters. No text.
shots.narration: 按国家标准选型，问清老师。

shots.scene: 【实拍】戴好口罩，双手指尖沿鼻梁按压鼻夹（正面特写，上半张脸不入镜）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up front view: both fingertips press the metal nose clip of a particulate respirator along the bridge of the nose.
shots.narration: 戴好后，双手按紧鼻夹。

shots.scene: 【实拍】双手捂住口罩用力呼气吸气，检查边缘漏气（正面中景）
shots.prompt_en: Medium front view: both hands cover the particulate respirator while the person breathes out and in to check for edge leaks.
shots.narration: 捂住口罩呼吸，检查不漏气。

shots.scene: 胡须让边缘漏缝；适合性检验
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a beard creating gaps under a mask edge crossed out, and a person in a fit testing hood. No text.
shots.narration: 首次使用，要做适合性检验。

shots.scene: 呼吸费力、口罩变脏破损就更换
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dirty and torn particulate mask with a heavy breathing icon, an arrow to a new mask. No text.
shots.narration: 呼吸费劲或破损，就换新的。

shots.scene: 肺和粉尘图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: lungs with a dust cloud and a warning sign. No text.
shots.narration: 粉尘烟尘伤肺，是职业病危害。

shots.scene: 称量罩和纳米颗粒盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a powder weighing enclosure next to a shield in front of nanoparticles. No text.
shots.narration: 细粉进罩，纳米材料从严。

shots.scene: 湿布和口罩
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a damp cloth wiping a bench and a well sealed particulate respirator. No text.
shots.narration: 湿擦不干扫，口罩选对戴严。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着体检表挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a blank health checkup form and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：职业健康监护与特殊人群。
